notes.title: Customization in Sumo Tatami
notes.content:
Sumo Tatami is a multiplayer arcade racing game with platformer elements. We want to provide players with the experience of fun and crazy races with guns and physics. Therefore, this game must have a customization system so that players can express their individuality to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/7bccf3258f8e7df6158a0254a1533aa70f93d2b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/ebd3a40d23e4b5eccf4fdb627b206a6bb755bdd8.png[/img]

In Sumo Tatami, players have access to a range of options that will make their sumo wrestlers look unique and express their player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/f0cb6c19b3da2085e2b70fc1f9751e84d3b4c5a4.png[/img]

First, the player can customize the sumo wrestler's skin. The character, like a chameleon, can turn pale, tan, or even green if you're feeling particularly zany today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/cd1a7b11bf8274b79164da1f287375350d39a636.png[/img]

But that's not all that can be done to the character's skin. The player can choose from a list of tattoos that will be drawn on the sumo wrestler's body. Of course, the tattoo will be visible only if it will not be covered by clothes, but sometimes you can afford to shine such a manly body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/c4933645e45d816b96920811bf4e3db9462c9a05.png[/img]

Secondly, there is of course the clothing. The player can dress up the sumo wrestler in different sets of clothes, or even mix them up amongst themselves to create their own individual style. A cowboy hat and a Viking cape can fit your current fighting mood unexpectedly well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/158966021af1cd884fc74c5141f93fec23d4a1cc.png[/img]

A sumo wrestler's closet falls into several categories:
[list]
[*] Shoes: sandals, boots or even slippers;
[*] Pants: shorts, pants, and the traditional sumo wrestler's loincloth, which is called mawashi;
[*] Hands: these are gloves of various kinds, except boxing gloves because they belong to a separate weapon slot;
[*] Body: shirts, cloaks, robes and armor, this is perhaps the most diverse element of customization;
[*] Face: masks, glasses and facial vegetation;
[*] Headwear: hats, caps and caps to complete the perfect look. Or, instead of headgear, you can opt for a trendy hairstyle.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/df4819c983cc3d12ed6dbde6dd1af54f9a8f28fc.png[/img]

You can even change the color for hairstyles and some sets of clothes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/e05baf72b482e3b5c21ca79e26a734efd433cf14.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/01f79a882fe1b5a2e227f050a2feb2f49f46b870.png[/img]

And thirdly, it is of course the sumo wrestler's weapons. For each type of weapon in the game there are different skins, which will affect not only the appearance of the weapon, but also the effects of its shots and attacks. Among our concepts, for example, there is a harpoon that fires sticky chewing gum instead of a cat hook (WARNING, this product is not suitable for eating!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/f6974c0e81d7487a4f2175baecc1408cb1a0894c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/101a86cc4a19bfc3a48654cc43a7d58bf06a7a88.png[/img]

And what kind of weapons and how they work we will tell you in one of the next devlogs!
By the way, what skin would you like the developers to add to the game?
